context:
Tuning mode label is simple: read tuning_mode from manifest, render a
styled badge (Tuned=green, No Tuning=gray, Auto=blue). Mirror the
TrustBadge component pattern.

Tuning config panel on detail page: lazy-fetch the .tuning.json sidecar
URL (already derivable from bundle_path convention). Render as a
collapsible key-value table. Only fetch on expand - not on page load.

Cross-tuning comparison: the strategy doc says tuning_mode is a
comparability-breaking dimension that should warn, not hard-block. The
warning must be visually prominent (yellow banner) but must not prevent
the comparison from rendering - a user may intentionally compare tuned
vs notuning to see the delta.
description:
Post-launch audit (2026-04-14) found that the explorer records only
`has_tuning: boolean` despite tuning config being one of BenchBox's
primary differentiators. A visitor comparing DuckDB "tuned" vs "notuning"
runs has no way to know they differ on this axis, let alone see what
tuning was applied.

This TODO:
  1. Surfaces tuning_mode ("tuned" / "notuning" / "auto") as a visible
     label on result detail pages and browse tables
  2. Loads and displays the tuning config summary from the .tuning.json
     sidecar (if present) on the detail page
  3. Enables the Compare view to show a tuning-mode label per result so
     cross-tuning comparisons are legible (not blocked - just labeled)

Prerequisite: explorer-extend-manifest-and-pipeline must land first
(tuning_mode and tuning_hash must be in the manifest).

anti_patterns.why: most visitors won't expand the panel
intentional tuned vs notuning comparisons are valid and valuable

anti_patterns.instead: show tuning_mode and tuning summary instead
anti_patterns.why: it is an internal grouping key

preserves.behavior: Existing compare view behavior when tuning is the same across both results (no regression)
Results without a .tuning.json sidecar render cleanly - tuning panel shows 'No tuning config recorded' not an error
TrustBadge layout unchanged - TuningBadge is a separate element

verifications.description: Tuning badge renders in browse tables

work_units.summary: Add tuning_mode label to BenchmarkIndex and PlatformIndex browse tables: small badge (styled like trust_label badge) showing 'Tuned' / 'No Tuning' / 'Auto'. Use tuning_mode from manifest.
Add tuning section to ResultDetail.tsx: show tuning_mode prominently; collapsible panel lazy-fetches .tuning.json sidecar and renders key-value config.
Update Compare.tsx: add tuning_mode label per result in the comparison header. If the two results have different tuning_mode values, show a visible 'Different tuning config' warning badge.
Add tuning filter to DuckDB-WASM browse queries: allow filtering by tuning_mode in Browse pages (All / Tuned / No Tuning). Uses tuning_mode column added by pipeline extension.
